title: Lieb's permanent dominance conjecture for immanants
statement:
Let $A$ be a positive semidefinite Hermitian matrix, let $\lambda\vdash n$ be a partition, let $\chi^{\lambda}$ be the irreducible character of $\mathfrak{S}_n$ indexed by $\lambda$, and let $\operatorname{Imm}_{\chi^{\lambda}}(A)$ denote the corresponding $\lambda$-immanant. Write $\operatorname{per}(A)$ for the permanent of $A$. **Lieb's conjecture.** For every such $A$ and $\lambda$, the permanent dominates the $\lambda$-immanant:

$$
\chi^{\lambda}(1)\operatorname{per}(A)\geq \operatorname{Imm}_{\chi^{\lambda}}(A).
$$

The paper describes determining the maximal immanant as a longstanding open problem, and presents this conjecture as Lieb's proposed answer; no resolution is supplied in the given text.
references:
**4 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2018–2025). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2202.01867](https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.01867), [arXiv:2101.03428](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.03428), [arXiv:1804.02231](https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.02231).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.20382

Status: **open** according to the source (as of August 2025). “A longstanding open problem is to determine the maximal immanant.”
source_name: Naihuan Jing, Yinlong Liu and Jian Zhang, “Immanant inequalities and weight spaces”, arXiv:2508.20382 (2025).
